text:
alexa: Heads-up: on master I'm seeing steady GPU memory increase on long-running chat workloads. Not a jump, but ~30-50MB/hour until OOM. Attached a short repro and profiler snapshots. Suspect allocator/fragmentation but can't rule out buffer leak.

kevin: Do you have nvprof/nvmetrics traces and kernel selection logs? Also which model and sequence length distribution?

alexa: Model: rdl-small-qlora; seq dist: 512(80%), 128(15%), 64(5%). nvprof gist:
```
GPU memory timeline: 0s=10.2GB 30m=10.8GB 60m=11.4GB
allocator stats: total_reserved=12.3GB resident=11.9GB free_slabs=420MB slab_frag_pct=8.5
kernel selection: aten_gemm_fused (80%), fast_attn_warp (20%)
```
Repro command:
```
python tools/repro_longrun.py --iters 20000 --batch 4 --pin-kvcache
```
Script posts periodic inference requests and keeps KV cache pinned.

tara: Pinning KV cache could mask eviction policy issues. Try toggle --pin-kvcache off and run with allocator hysteresis enabled: `allocator.reuse_window_s=60` and `workspace.headroom_ratio=0.12`.

kevin: Also try our staging build with buffer-reuse fix (build: pr/infra/2598) — it changes when slabs are coalesced and adds a small delay before releasing to CUDA.

alexa: Ran 2h A/B: baseline vs reuse_window=60 + pr/2598. Baseline grew ~0.9GB/hr; patched run stable within ±40MB. P50 latency +2%, throughput unchanged. nvprof shows fewer transient alloc/free spikes.

jia: Sounds like allocator hysteresis + delayed release helped. Could still be micro-fragmentation from kernel footprints: when fast_attn_warp uses different scratch sizes we can leave small holes. Suggest adding a per-kernel workspace bucketizer that rounds scratch sizes to cache-friendly sizes.

kevin: Good call. Also add a small regression test that runs the repro for 30m in CI with memory asserts (peak <= 11.5GB). If it fails, capture cudasamples and kernel footprint histogram.

alexa: I'll open PR with repro test, config flags, and the run logs. Posting evidence and commands in #eng-runtime-artifacts.

infra-bot: nightly/regression run queued: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/3724

tara: If PR goes green, let's flip default reuse_window to 30s for Dedicated to reduce tail risk. Keep 60s for Private until more telemetry.

kevin: Agreed. Assigning follow-ups: alexa -> PR + test, kevin -> kernel bucketizer prototype, jia -> KV eviction tuning. Tagging @oncall for awareness.

alexa: thanks all, will follow up with PR link and logs.
